qc_policy.A_reference_variability: For each rule/radius, report SD and SE across references; dataset variability is omitted because the manual-rule MNIST stage has one dataset per rule.
qc_policy.B_unit_logZ_stability: For each rule/radius, report q95 and max split logZ/P difference across reference units.
qc_policy.ess_policy: ESS is not a separate figure policy here because it is managed by the tempered path sampler.

derivative_curve_policy: Standalone derivative and A-measure panels use sampling-time direct radial score derivative from dlogZ_inf_full_dr / P.
production_derivative_requirement: Final production dphi/dd uses sampling-time direct radial derivative, dlogZ_inf_full_dr / P, not finite differences.
